title: Show a failed turn in the conversation with its reason and a Retry
description:
Web half of chatticus-a20667. Today turn.failed clears the bot bubble and shows the reason as small dismissable text under the composer; after a reload nothing is shown.

Feature: A failed turn stays visible
  Scenario: A failed turn keeps a bubble with the reason
    Given a turn fails with reason "The model provider refused the request: the account is out of credits or over its quota."
    Then the conversation shows a failed reply with that reason
    And the member can retry the message
  Scenario: Retrying re-sends the original message as a new turn
  Scenario: A failed turn is still shown after the page reloads
  Scenario: A turn with no progress for a while says it is taking longer than expected

Needs an API to read the latest turn of a channel even when it is no longer active (GET /channels/{id}/turn 404s for non-active turns).
right_now_summary: The team is adding persistent failed-turn bubbles with reasons and a retry option.
